title: Let praise become the place you live
summary: This meets the self that still wants peace while staying at the center. The line says peace grows by serving the Guru and dwelling in the praise carried by the Shabad.
takeaway: Serve and let praise house the heart.
lifeApplication: Before centering yourself in the conversation again, do the next obedient thing and keep one line of praise nearby. Let the heart live there instead.

source.shortMeaning: Peace deepens when praise, service, and Shabad replace self-importance.
source.lifeApplication: When ego reaches for the center, move into service and praise instead.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace deepens when praise, service, and Shabad replace self-importance.
evidence.turn: Serve first, and let peace expose the self.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before centering yourself in the conversation again, do the next obedient thing and keep one line of praise nearby. Let the heart live there instead.
